## Standing operator rules
- Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
- Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in `requirements/license-tools.txt` rather than using `>=` or a floating latest version.
- Run “Elasticsearch Reindex Alias Swap” in between other work, one step at a time and in order.
- can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

## Current objective
Optimize tenant search rebuilds; the dunning-email scheduler fix remains unfinished.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is frozen—never seed or write into it. Orders: `orders_v1` → `orders_v2`, alias `orders`; cluster `production` is yellow; host `localhost:9200`. Canonical currency: `args.currency`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook-level five-attempt retry decorator caused duplicate emails. Sequential per-invoice embedding was too slow.

## Recent work
Added tenant-scoped, concurrent chunked embedding; a 5,000-invoice dry run completed in 1.19s. Search tests: 33 passed. Full suite: 44 passed. Shared embedder wiring was added; Elasticsearch swap step 5 remains pending.
